⏳ Building…
What this tool does & which files it reads
  • Reads: .xlsx, .xlsm, .xls, .xlsb, .ods, .csv, .tsv. Multi-tab workbooks: every lane tab is converted; instruction, fuel-table and history tabs are skipped and listed under “Not included”.
  • Layouts: bid sheets with buried or decorated headers, combined “City, ST ZIP” columns, one-sided lists (the missing end comes from an “OUTBOUND <City, ST>” title or the overrides above), 3-digit ZIP groups, rate grids, street-address sheets and carrier tender sheets.
  • Locations: a whole-state lane uses the state's central city (Indiana → Indianapolis). A region uses the workbook's own region key when it has one — the central city of what the key lists. Known misspellings and one-letter typos are corrected and noted; a state the customer gave is never overwritten, only flagged.
  • Volume: an annual column, or Jan–Dec monthly columns summed. A lane with no volume is written as 1 load.
  • Customer miles: when the sheet gives a mileage per lane it goes into the QR's Customer Miles column as given.
  • Equipment: DRY→VAN, FROZEN/COOLER→REEFER, flatbed family→FLAT; or force one above.
  • ZIPs & mileage: a missing ZIP is looked up from the city (USPS primary ZIP) or a 3-digit / Canadian FSA reference. Mileage is PC*MILER zip-to-zip with a city/state fallback. Rate columns are left blank. Every file is integrity-checked before download.
  • Nothing leaves your computer — the file is read and built entirely in this browser tab.
